summary: U-BX Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a best-efforts public offering of 15,166,668 units at $0.30 per unit, each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and a warrant to purchase 0.3 of a Class A ordinary share at $0.30. The offering raised approximately $4.55 million in gross proceeds, issued under an effective shelf registration statement. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The company intends to use net proceeds for working capital and R&D. There are no unusual terms or structural features that would classify this as an event-driven special situation.
